purpose: Explain selected-vehicle outage evidence, unknown telemetry intervals and original-event-time replay, and download the original session certificate.
primaryGoal: Understand what remains known during an outage without treating missing evidence as zero, then retain the certificate evidence as JSON.

dataSources.name: outageQuery
dataSources.sourceOwnership: physicsHandler.Outage; handler internals and backend production behavior were not inspected.
dataSources.behavior: Vehicle-scoped physics/outage cache key; enabled only with a vehicle ID; request receives cancellation signal; historical query policy. Page derives live-provenance DataState and preserves its retained payload.
unknowns: Server default reporting interval, source freshness and collection semantics are unverified.

dataSources.name: certificateQuery
dataSources.sourceOwnership: physicsHandler.Certificate; handler internals, integrity verification and server interval selection were not inspected.
dataSources.behavior: Independent vehicle-scoped physics/certificate cache key, vehicle prerequisite, cancellation signal and historical query policy. Historical DataState warning/error handling does not suppress outage evidence. Download uses the original query payload, not a presentation projection.

dataSources.name: workspace vehicle and presentation preferences
dataSources.behavior: Consumes useSelectedVehicle without a competing picker; no page date controls or fixed reporting range. useNumberFormatting retains locale and numeric precision; formatDateTime remains the timestamp display owner.
unknowns: Vehicle-provider implementation and actual header vehicle visibility were not exercised or traced.

issues.detail: Certificate action selects Button size=sm, whose h-9 base is 36px, below the contract's stronger 44px mobile default. It does not opt into the existing wrapLabel behavior; long translated labels need allocated-width testing.
issues.fix: Reuse Button's existing sizing/className and wrapLabel props to provide a mobile 44px minimum and preserve long labels; measure actual composed target/spacing before declaring a WCAG failure.
issues.confidence: high for source sizing; runtime target and overflow unverified

responsive.viewportChecks: Not run at 320,375,390,430,768,1024,1280,1440,1920 or 2560px; no clipping or successful reflow claim.

states.loading: Independent initial query loading maps to SourceContent and summary suppression at page lines 58,80,108. Shared summary and details values suppress measurements during loading (OperationalBrief.tsx:191-196,256-263).
states.empty: Outage and certificate have localized empty copy at page lines 82 and 110.
states.error: Outage fatal failure uses SourceContent with retry at page lines 80-85; certificate fatal failure uses QueryError with independent retry at lines 104-105.
states.retained: Both source warnings are mounted separately at page lines 50 and 103; retained payload is not dropped after refresh failure.
states.offline: Retained paused sources have shared warnings, but initial paused requests have no explicit prerequisite/offline representation here.
states.unknown: MQTT null is distinct from false; missing timestamp is a dash; gap_s stays undefined/null rather than zero; unknown_since explains missingness at page lines 54-75.
states.disabled: Certificate action disabled until query payload exists, with an additional onClick guard at page lines 38-41.

issues.detail: With no selected vehicle, both hooks are disabled (useTeslaPhysics.ts:104,124), but lack of data is rendered as no recorded evidence/no available certificate. An initial paused request similarly has no data and isLoading is false. Neither condition establishes an authoritative empty result.
issues.fix: Distinguish vehicle prerequisite and initial offline/paused loading from resolved empty using vehicleId, query flags and DataState.isRefreshBlocked. Reuse SourceContent.emptyContent and existing feedback; retain both panels and workspace-owned vehicle selection.
issues.confidence: high for source branch logic; mounted outcomes unverified

issues.detail: Summary retained flag is hasData && isError only. A paused retained source is stale in DataState but SystemSummaryBrief chooses Source available; fatal initial failure is summarized as unavailable without failure context. The adjacent warning/error remains present, so this is a summary trust mismatch rather than loss of content.
issues.fix: Derive summary retention/context from the shared DataState status, including paused refresh; reuse available retained and statusLabel props with localized failure/offline context rather than adding another trust registry.

issues.detail: A nonempty outage object with replay_preserves_event_time=false and notes=[] produces a ready but visually contentless evidence panel. The null-safe list avoids a crash, but there is no explanation for the missing details.
issues.fix: Keep the evidence panel and summary; add localized detail-unavailable content when neither replay assurance nor notes exist. Do not invent a replay failure or interpret absent notes as zero incidents.
issues.confidence: high for conditional rendering; backend occurrence unknown

visualIssues.detail: The first evidence surface has no explicit section title while the certificate surface has PanelTitle. It can become a blank framed block under the ready-without-details case recorded in states.
visualIssues.fix: Use the existing PanelTitle and source-appropriate localized heading while preserving replay assurance and every note. Keep one section shell, not another nested card.
visualIssues.confidence: high for source hierarchy; visual severity unverified

architectureIssues.detail: Page declares live provenance although the hook selects historical policy. That policy has five-minute staleTime and no interval/reconnect/focus refresh (queryPolicy.ts:156-166). DataState has no maxAgeMs here. Current-looking MQTT/gap evidence therefore needs a source-freshness review, not an assumed live guarantee.
architectureIssues.fix: Confirm physicsHandler.Outage source semantics with the integration owner before changing provenance or refresh policy. Reuse existing queryPolicy/DataState contracts, retain current query keys/cancellation and avoid silently adding polling.
architectureIssues.confidence: high for source configuration mismatch; backend freshness unknown

priority.reason: Already uses shared layout, metrics, source-state handling and null-safe display; prioritize truthful prerequisite/offline/summary states, detail-empty clarity and mobile action reachability rather than redesigning architecture.
order: empty detail explanation and section hierarchy
mobile action sizing and long labels

competingImplementations.assessment: No competing formatter, fetch layer, picker, overlay, state registry or surface implementation in the inspected page. Preserve SystemSummaryBrief over OperationalBrief and the existing SourceContent pipeline.
competingImplementations.sharedChangeDecision: None required by current bounded evidence. Existing SourceContent emptyContent, Button wrapLabel/className and SystemSummaryBrief retained/statusLabel props cover the page findings. Freshness policy review is an integration dependency, not authorization to edit shared code.
competingImplementations.visualNoiseCheck: Assigned-page source has zero matches for neon, glow, fixed white, hex-white or saturation patterns. Shared OperationalBrief uses semantic toned text and variable surfaces; its theme-primary accent is preference-driven, not proof of unnecessary saturation. Actual composed themes, glow and contrast remain unverified.

actions: Download original certificate payload as dated session-certificate-YYYY-MM-DD.json; retain data guard, all boundaries/rules/hash/HMAC/honesty fields and JSON formatting (page:35-46; csvExport.ts:139-164).
Retry outage fatal source (page:85) and certificate fatal source (page:105) independently.
Refresh retained source via each StaleRefreshWarning; retry disabled while refreshing (page:50,103; StaleRefreshWarning.ts:103-114).
Open/close operational review-details drawer, retain narrative, source scope/freshness, all three metrics and provenance (OperationalBrief.tsx:150-160,235-270).
Retain header freshness metadata and localized honesty help, inherited through PageContainer.
dataBehavior: Use workspace-selected vehicle, stringified only for typed hooks; no duplicate page picker or invented date range.
Keep independent physics/outage and physics/certificate keys, vehicle prerequisite, cancellation signals, raw payloads and existing policy until integration review authorizes changes.
Keep telemetry gap raw seconds; divide by 60 only for display using saved numeric precision/locale. Keep unknown distinct from measured zero.
Keep MQTT unknown/connected/disconnected labels and neutral/success/warning semantics.
Retain last telemetry original event time, unknown_since gap explanation, honesty, every note and replay event-time assurance.
Preserve independent loading, empty, fatal retry, retained refresh warning and download readiness; do not gate all sections behind outage success.
No backend evidence, additional metrics, fake queue counts, unsupported reporting period or source-unit conversion may be invented.
